name: core-speed
description: 4 prompt tipo, 300 token massimi, temperatura 0, seed 1 e 2. Una misura conta solo se il modello genera almeno 40 token. Serve per confrontare velocita (e accettazione del drafter) tra macchine diverse con lo stesso metro.

prompts.codice: Write a Python module with a class Graph (add_edge, bfs, dijkstra) and full docstrings.
prompts.storia: Write a vivid 300 word story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.
prompts.ragionamento: A train leaves at 9:10 at 80 km/h, another at 9:40 at 100 km/h on the same track. When does the second catch up? Show every step.
prompts.json: Return a JSON array of 8 objects with keys id, name, email, tags (array of 3 strings). JSON only.
